config.note: The warm curve is the rigorous worst-case bound on membership-inference advantage for an (ε, δ)-DP mechanism, Adv ≤ (e^ε − 1 + 2δ)/(e^ε + 1) (Humphries et al., 'Differentially Private Learning Does Not Bound Membership Inference'), at δ = 1e-5. Advantage = 2·(attack accuracy − ½). The cool dots are measured DP-SGD test accuracy at the stated ε (δ = 1e-5); the small warm dots are measured empirical attack advantage on CIFAR-10. Utility numbers: CIFAR-10 from scratch and ImageNet fine-tuning from De et al. 2022 (arXiv:2204.13650) and the DP-SGD image-classification literature; ImageNet-from-scratch ResNet-50 from the same lineage. No runtime fetches — every number is snapshotted here.
